missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Эпоха' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'началась'. 'Новая' is the agreeing feminine adjective marking a fresh era.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Эпоху' is the accusative direct object of 'изучают'. 'Эту' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'историки' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Эпохи' is genitive modifying 'музыка' to mean the music of that era. 'Той' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'спокойной' is the instrumental predicate.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В эпохе' uses the prepositional form 'эпохе' after 'в' to place us within an era. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.

missions.phrase: Это здание относится к древней эпохе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Эпохе' is in the dative case after 'к' to assign the building to an era. 'Древней' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Эпохой' is in the instrumental case governed by 'восхищается'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, marking admiration.

missions.phrase: До этой эпохи люди жили иначе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Эпохи' is genitive after 'до' to mark a time before. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'люди' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Эпохи' is the nominative plural subject of 'оставили'. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'следы' is the accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Эпохи' is genitive after 'из' to mark the origin in time. 'Прошлой' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'картина' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Эпоха' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'имеет'. 'Каждая' agrees in the feminine, and 'стиль' is the accusative object.
